## Farmer-facing change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include a screenshot or short recording for UI changes when useful.

## Data and integrations

State which data sources, permissions and external services the change needs, and how missing or stale data is handled.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant backend tests
- [ ] Relevant frontend tests and TypeScript check
- [ ] Production frontend build, when applicable
- [ ] Manual check of the changed workspace flow
- [ ] No credentials, local data or real farmer details in the diff
